title: Flatness is tested on finitely generated ideals
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $M$ an $R$-module. Then $M$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] if and only if for every finitely generated ideal $\mathfrak a\subset R$ the $R$-linear map $\mathfrak a\otimes_RM\to M$, $x\otimes m\mapsto xm$, is injective.

mathlib_searches.query: a module is flat iff for every finitely generated ideal I the map I ⊗ M → M is injective
